import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Card, Row, Col } from 'react-bootstrap'; import axios from 'axios'; const API_URL = 'http://localhost:5000/api'; function Dashboard() { const [stats, setStats] = useState({ scheduler: {}, memory: {}, vfs: {} }); useEffect(() => { fetchStats(); }, []); const fetchStats = async () => { try { const [schedulerRes, memoryRes, vfsRes] = await Promise.all([ axios.get(`${API_URL}/scheduler/stats`), axios.get(`${API_URL}/memory/stats`), axios.get(`${API_URL}/vfs/stats`) ]); setStats({ scheduler: schedulerRes.data, memory: memoryRes.data, vfs: vfsRes.data }); } catch (error) { console.error('Error fetching stats:', error); } }; return (

System Dashboard

CPU Utilization
{stats.scheduler.cpu_utilization || 0}%
Memory Hit Ratio
{stats.memory.hit_ratio ? stats.memory.hit_ratio.toFixed(1) : 0}%
Storage Used
{stats.vfs.used_blocks || 0} / {stats.vfs.total_blocks || 0}
CPU Scheduler Status

Algorithm: {stats.scheduler.algorithm || 'N/A'}

Avg Waiting Time: {stats.scheduler.avg_waiting_time || 0}

Avg Turnaround Time: {stats.scheduler.avg_turnaround_time || 0}

Avg Response Time: {stats.scheduler.avg_response_time || 0}

 Memory Management Status

Algorithm: {stats.memory.algorithm || 'N/A'}

Page Faults: {stats.memory.page_faults || 0}

Page Hits: {stats.memory.page_hits || 0}

Frames Used: {stats.memory.used_frames || 0} / {stats.memory.total_frames || 0}

 File System Status

Total Inodes: {stats.vfs.total_inodes || 0}

Used Inodes: {stats.vfs.used_inodes || 0}

Total Blocks: {stats.vfs.total_blocks || 0}

Block Size: {stats.vfs.block_size || 0} bytes
); } export default Dashboard;
